US Firm Fires 80 Indian Employees in Brief Video Call

A US-based firm terminated the employment of 80 Indian employees during a five-minute Google Meet video conference. Employees from the Indian support team have alleged they were fired during this brief call. Details regarding the specific firm and the reasons for the termination were not provided in the coverage.
